notes: Read all 140 source lines before editing. Module is the dashboard 'System Health' widget; its purpose (read system-health + db-stats + connection-pool admin queries, render a compact overall-status summary on 1-col layouts and a service-status grid + 4-tile StatCard grid on wider layouts, EmptyState when health has no data, health-driven freshness/loading/error) is preserved in the native header comment.

Imports (L1-9): react useMemo (L1) preserved; react-i18next useTranslation (L2) -> a local English-fallback useTranslation('dashboard') with t(key, fallback?) preserving every key verbatim; lucide-react Server (L3) -> the SemanticIcon 'server' glyph rendered as a colour-tinted AppText (GlyphIcon); @/components/data-display StatusBadge + StatCard (L4) -> local native StatusBadge (overall pill) + StatCard (label/value tile); @/components/feedback EmptyState (L5) -> the native parity EmptyState; @/api/hooks/useAdmin useSystemHealth/useDBStats/useConnectionPool (L6) -> the already-ported native parity hooks (same names/return shapes/API paths /system/health, /dev-tools/db-stats, /dev-tools/runtime-info); @/lib/numberFormat fmtInt (L7) -> inlined fmtInt(v)=fmtNumber(v,0) via safeNumber + en-US locale; ./WidgetShell WidgetShell (L8) -> a local native WidgetShell covering the props used; ./types WidgetProps (L9) + WidgetSize/WidgetConfig ported verbatim as local types.

SERVICE_KEYS (L13-18) ported verbatim as an `as const` array of {key,i18n,emoji} for database/mqtt/tesla_api/fleet_telemetry (the 🟢 emoji field is carried across though, as in the source standard layout, it is not rendered — the standard layout uses StatusDot, not the emoji).

statusColor (L20-24): web returns Tailwind 'bg-{green-500|amber-400|red-500} shadow-{...}/40' -> native returns the success/warning/danger token colour; ok/healthy -> success, degraded -> warning, else -> danger. The shadow-[0_0_6px] glow is reproduced in StatusDot via shadowColor=colour + shadowRadius 6 + shadowOpacity 0.4.

StatusDot (L26-28): web <span> h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_6px] {statusColor} -> a 10x10 RN View (borderRadius 5) with backgroundColor + shadowColor = statusColor(status); accessibility-hidden as decorative.

overallLabel (L30-34) ported verbatim: healthy -> t('widget.systemHealth.healthy','Healthy'); degraded -> t('widget.systemHealth.degraded','Degraded'); else -> t('widget.systemHealth.down','Down'). The (key,fallback)=>string TFunc param is preserved.
overallBadgeStatus (L36-40) ported verbatim: healthy -> 'online'; degraded -> 'away'; else -> 'offline'.

String(health.error) : null (L70); hasData=health.data != null (L71).

WidgetShell call (L73-84): title isCompact ? undefined : t('widget.systemHealth.title','System Health'); icon the web Server (text-neon-green h-3.5 -> GlyphIcon color success size 13); loading isLoading; error hasError; updatedAt health.dataUpdatedAt; isFetching health.isFetching; isStale health.isStale; isError health.isError; onRefresh ()=>health.refetch() — all preserved. The local shell renders a Skeleton while loading, an inline error block (testID widget-error) on error, then the header row (icon + uppercase title + DataFreshness) and body; freshness 'Error' state surfaces isError as in web.

Compact branch (L86-96): hasData && isCompact -> a centred column (items/justify center, gap, minHeight 44, web min-h-[44px]) with <StatusBadge status={overallBadgeStatus(overallStatus)} size='sm' /> (L89), a semibold primary 14px label overallLabel(overallStatus, t) (L90-92), and a secondary 12px caption `{healthyCount}/{services.length} {t('widget.systemHealth.services','services')}` (L93-95).

StatusBadge native (web @/components/data-display StatusBadge): a pill (surfaceRaised bg + border, rounded-full) + a coloured dot + the capitalized status text (web `capitalize` + dark text-secondary). The web dot colour comes from getStateDefinition('vehicle', status).badgeDot: 'online' (variant success) -> green; 'offline' (variant danger, no badgeDot override) -> red; 'away' is NOT a registered vehicle FSM state so getStateDefinition returns the neutral DEFAULT_STATE -> grey badgeDot. That grey-for-'away'/degraded resolution is reproduced faithfully via BADGE_DOT { online: success, away: textMuted, offline: danger } rather than 'fixing' it to amber, preserving the source's actual rendered output. size='sm' maps to the web sm tokens (dot 6px, text-xs 12px, gap-1, px-1.5 py-0.5).

Standard branch (L97-129): hasData && !isCompact -> a flex column (gap). Service status grid (L100-108): web grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-2 -> a flex-wrap row (columnGap lg = gap-x-4, rowGap sm = gap-y-2) of services.map rows, each min-h-[44px] with a StatusDot + a truncate text-xs secondary label (L102-107), keyed by svc.key. Stats grid (L111-128): web grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-auto -> a flex-wrap row (gap sm, marginTop:'auto' = mt-auto) of four StatCard cells (flexBasis 47%): DB Size = dbSize (L112-115); Active Conns = maxConns>0 ? `${fmtInt(activeConns)}/${fmtInt(maxConns)}` : fmtInt(activeConns) (L116-119); Memory = memory!=null ? `${fmtInt(memory)} MB` : '—' (L120-123); Goroutines = goroutines!=null ? fmtInt(goroutines) : '—' (L124-127). All four labels go through t(...) verbatim.

StatCard native (web @/components/data-display StatCard): a raised card (surfaceRaised bg + border, radius 10) with a muted caption label + a bold primary 18px value, covering all four label/value call sites (the source passes no icon/trend/sublabel/loading here, so those StatCard features are intentionally omitted).

Empty branch (L131-137): !hasData -> EmptyState with the web Server (h-5 w-5, no colour -> GlyphIcon color textSecondary size 18), message t('widget.systemHealth.noData','No system health data'), className py-4 -> styles.emptyState paddingVertical spacing.md. The web inline 'no-action' transient-empty-state comment (L132) is reflected by the EmptyState having no action.

Closing JSX + default export (L138-140) preserved. Native-safe GlyphIcon/DataFreshness/WidgetShell mirror the sibling parity widgets (BatteryCellsWidget/LiveSignalsWidget). DataFreshness computes its relative time once at render (no interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles; it is a Pressable(onRefresh) dot+label whose state is error>fetching>stale>fresh.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives, the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useAdmin hooks. Verified: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit, exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (exit 0), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` pass incl. the added __tests__/SystemHealthWidget.test.tsx covering the standard service+stat grids (Database/Mqtt/Tesla Api/Fleet Telemetry, DB Size 1.2 GB, 3/25 conns, 128 MB, 87 goroutines), the dbStats databaseSize fallback + bare-inUse (maxOpen 0) + em-dash placeholders, the compact Online/Healthy + 2/4 services summary, the degraded->Away/Degraded and unhealthy->Offline/Down mappings, the no-data EmptyState, the loading Skeleton, the inline error block, and the freshness->refetch press.
